description__en: A harvested fruit sells for its crop's base value, scaled by its weight, its variant and its mutations. The community wiki publishes the formula; we have not tested it in the game ourselves.
definition__en: A harvested fruit sells for its crop's base value, scaled by its weight, its variant and its mutations. The community wiki publishes the formula; we have not tested it in the game ourselves.

description__en: Value grows with the square of (weight / base weight). Fruits lighter than 95% of the base weight still sell as if they weighed 95% of it.
definition__en: Value grows with the square of (weight / base weight). Fruits lighter than 95% of the base weight still sell as if they weighed 95% of it.

description__en: Each mutation and each variant has a fixed Sheckle multiplier.
definition__en: Each mutation and each variant has a fixed Sheckle multiplier.

description__en: Mutations add up: each one adds its multiplier minus 1, so Shocked (x100) and Frozen (x10) make x109, not x1000. A variant (Silver, Gold, Rainbow and others) then multiplies that total. A fruit has one variant at a time.
